query:
Find applicable evidence-backed ways to reduce execution time in this GitHub Actions workflow. Consider its jobs, dependencies, commands, triggers, and repository manifests.
# CI: Build & Test
#
# Purpose:
#   - Run repository checks: setup, install, test, and build.
#   - Ensure a minimal, reproducible environment for quick CI feedback.
#
# Triggers:
#   - push, pull_request, workflow_dispatch
#
# Security & reproducibility notes:
#   - Use least-privilege permissions (contents: read) and pin action versions where appropriate.
#   - Use local caches to speed builds and reduce external load.

name: "CI: Build & Test"

on:
  pull_request:
  push:
    branches:
      - "**" # Listen to pushes on all branches
    tags-ignore:
      - "**" # Ignore tag pushes
  workflow_dispatch:

# Use concurrency to deduplicate runs.
# - For pull requests: group by `pr-<number>` so multiple commits to the same PR
#   cancel previous runs and only the latest is kept.
# - For direct pushes: fall back to deduplicating by commit SHA so identical
#   commits don't trigger multiple concurrent workflows.
# - Include the `github.workflow` name in the group to avoid cross-workflow collisions.
concurrency:
  group: ${{ github.workflow }}-${{ github.event_name == 'pull_request' && format('pr-{0}', github.event.pull_request.number) || github.sha }}
  cancel-in-progress: true

permissions:
  contents: read

jobs:
  build:
    name: "Build & Test"
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@9c091bb21b7c1c1d1991bb908d89e4e9dddfe3e0
        with:
          submodules: "recursive"

      - name: Setup bun
        uses: oven-sh/setup-bun@0c5077e51419868618aeaa5fe8019c62421857d6

      - name: Install project
        run: |
          cd vendor/obsidian-plugin-library
          bun install --frozen-lockfile --ignore-scripts
          bun run build:force
          cd ../..
          bun install --frozen-lockfile --ignore-scripts

      - name: Run tests
        run: bun run test

      - name: Build project
        run: bun run build

name: Checks

on:
  workflow_dispatch:
  pull_request:

jobs:
  checks:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    steps:
      # submodules: the SoloPlay submodule cannot be checked in isolation (its tsconfig points at
      # ../../sdk and ../../libs), so the parent checkout is where it gets validated - against the
      # exact commit this repo pins.
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v7
        with:
          submodules: recursive

      # Node 24: eslint-plugin-es-x@10 requires ^22.23.0 || ^24.18.0 || >=26.4.0, and
      # eslint@10 requires ^20.19.0 || ^22.13.0 || >=24. Anything older cannot run the toolchain.
      - name: Set up Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v7
        with:
          node-version: '24'
          cache: npm

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: npm ci

      # lint:check, never `lint` - that one is `eslint --fix`, which would rewrite files in CI
      # and let anything auto-fixable pass silently.
      - name: ESLint
        run: npm run lint:check

      - name: Typecheck
        run: npm run typecheck

      # The no-undef inventory is generated. If someone adds a global without regenerating,
      # the committed file goes stale and no-undef quietly stops covering it.
      - name: Globals inventory is current
        run: npm run globals:check

      - name: Typecheck (SoloPlay submodule)
        run: npm run typecheck:soloplay

      # Every runtime .js must belong to a TS program. A file in none gets no typechecking and
      # no editor intellisense, and nothing else reports it.
      - name: No orphaned files
        run: node tools/audit/program-files.mjs --check
